item.title: Version 1.3.4
item.description:
• The ORIGINAL half of a history card now shows what you actually said, with everything an AI Style removed struck through.
  • A replacement you add reaches re-style and retry too; one you delete stops rewriting old dictations.
  • The card shown when your free week ends quotes your own words, not your replacement list.

item.title: Version 1.3.3
item.description:
• The orb is smaller and much quieter at rest; while you dictate, a ring around it answers your voice.
  • Nothing swaps in the orb's middle any more — no level bars while recording, no glyph flashing during styling.
  • Tooltips, the status pill and the picker lists now share one look.
  • ⌘⇧Y opens the style picker from anywhere.
  • Add a replacement rule, not just a word, from the “+” card.
  • Dictate into the middle of a sentence without breaking it apart.
  • The first syllable is no longer clipped, and the first dictation after a pause no longer waits on a stale token.
  • Polish resolves a spoken self-correction; styles stopped inserting em dashes; a dropped connection no longer signs you out.

item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description:
• A shorter wait after you let the key go. The session that authorises a cloud upload is now renewed while you are still speaking, so the only thing left when you finish is sending the audio. A dictation that stays on your Mac never touches the network.
  • Kazhy tells you which version it is running: beside Check for Updates in the menu, and on the Help screen.
